neighbours.label: Wet-lab biochemistry and cell-biology methods text (purified from, isolated from, coupled with, reactivity with, pellet in the tube), vs everyday sentences using the same prepositions
fire: The recombinant protein was expressed in E. coli and purified from the soluble fraction.
Fibroblasts isolated from mouse skin were cultured in serum-free medium.
Peptides were separated by liquid chromatography coupled with tandem mass spectrometry.
The secondary antibody shows no cross-reactivity with rat or rabbit IgG.
Genomic DNA was extracted from leaf tissue using a commercial kit.
After centrifugation, discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in lysis buffer.
Lipase activity was measured in extracts from Aspergillus niger strains.
Plasmids were amplified in bacterial cultures and recovered with a miniprep column.
quiet: The new phone was shipped from the factory and arrived in a small box.
Volunteers from the town cleaned the beach every Saturday morning.
The dancers were paired with partners from the visiting school.
The farmer shows no interest in rabbits or other small animals.
Old letters were pulled from the attic and sorted into boxes.
After the storm, sweep the porch and put the cushions back on the chairs.
The bakery sells fresh bread from local wheat farms.
Books were collected in classrooms and returned to the library.

predictions: Lab-methods sentences 0.35-0.7, peaking on prepositions and organism/sample words; everyday sentences with the same words under 0.05.
notes: Card: peaks ' the', ' human', ' found', 'abbit', ' with', ' from' in protocols ('pellet in the bottom of the tube', 'Tested species reactivity Rabbit', 'alpha-amylases from Bacillus'); the - pole suppresses sample/specimen/laboratory words. Probe: 'coupled with mass spectrometry' 0.686, 'purified from Bacillus subtilis' 0.642, 'isolated from human tumors' 0.504, 'rabbit tissue' 0.385, 'bottom of the tube' 0.359; everyday rabbit/drawer/orchestra/hiking 0.006-0.026.
